gitCommit.subject: Console business page: a long address and a wide table keep inside their cards
gitCommit.body:
Console business page: a long address and a wide table keep inside their cards

Found by screenshots against the real API: on the console's business page a
verified email with its chip could not wrap, so a 375 px phone scrolled sideways
(up to 157 px with a long address), and at 1280 px the stores table ran under the
monthly total beside it, hiding its last columns.

- Every table sits in a scroller: wider than its card, it scrolls inside it.
- In a phone's labelled cards, a value keeps to its column: a row of address and
  chip wraps, and an address longer than the column breaks.
- A browser check holds the page at 375, 320 and 1280 px in every language, with a
  long verified address; it fails on the previous build in all three.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WqJ1WH6TJWfctbXGjyqFZt
